versions.subject: Merge PR #5173 from @X-Junior - New rule additions and some fixes
versions.detection:
selection_dll:
    ImageLoaded|endswith: '\clfs.sys'
selection_folders_1:
    Image|contains:
        - ':\Perflogs\'
        - ':\Users\Public\'
        - '\Temporary Internet'
        - '\Windows\Temp\'
selection_folders_2:
    - Image|contains|all:
          - ':\Users\'
          - '\Favorites\'
    - Image|contains|all:
          - ':\Users\'
          - '\Favourites\'
    - Image|contains|all:
          - ':\Users\'
          - '\Contacts\'
    - Image|contains|all:
          - ':\Users\'
          - '\Pictures\'
condition: selection_dll and 1 of selection_folders_*
versions.spl: ImageLoaded="*\\clfs.sys" Image IN ("*:\\Perflogs\\*", "*:\\Users\\Public\\*", "*\\Temporary Internet*", "*\\Windows\\Temp\\*") OR (Image="*:\\Users\\*" Image="*\\Favorites\\*") OR (Image="*:\\Users\\*" Image="*\\Favourites\\*") OR (Image="*:\\Users\\*" Image="*\\Contacts\\*") OR (Image="*:\\Users\\*" Image="*\\Pictures\\*")
